item.description:
Changes since v0.2.31:
- The 1.5-second quiet time after typing or a click is defined in the core library and pinned by a test (#186) - Gotchas: link previews are cached by address, and Slack picks the layout (#181) - The README hero hands use the deeper skin of the current 3D scene (ENS-117) (#180) - CodeQL runs on pull requests only when the Swift sources or package files change (#175) - The website's link preview carries the full tag set and an oEmbed photo for Slack (#179) - All four Claude windows on the home page show grey placeholder bars, and none shows Plan mode, Opus or Auto-accept off (#178) - The link preview image has a new address so validators stop showing the cached old one (#177)

Changes since v0.2.30:
- The hand is a deeper skin tone in the light theme so it stands out against the white stage (#176) - The website's link preview uses the repository's own social image (#174) - The home page hero is one 3D scene of the head, the Claude window and the hand, with a short note from the maker (#173) - A link to the website shows a preview image in Slack (ENS-116) (#172) - The friends' texts on the website are light lock-screen notifications, and Incredibly intuitive follows them directly (#171) - The home page closed-lid step shows the 3D closed laptop (#170) - The download section's gradient circle no longer overlaps the gallery (#169)

Changes since v0.2.29:
- The hand and head are lit skin under one shared light rig, and a closed laptop scene joins them (#168) - The home page safeguard gallery shows real keys, Claude windows, a permissions list and a cascade of tiles (#167)
